name: Default
shortDescription: Lightweight webmail client for existing IMAP and SMTP servers, with an admin panel for mail domains, plugins and settings.

alerts.message: The admin password is generated on first start and stored in /var/lib/snappymail/_data_/_default_/admin_password.txt. Read it from the container terminal, then sign in at https://<your-domain>/?admin as user admin and add the IMAP/SMTP domains your users will log in with.
